meta.feel: Mid/late-1980s Alaska salvage — calendar gates plus research points, no leapfrog tree
meta.notes: Era lock 1985–89. Vehicles: Jeeps, civilian pickups, early Humvees, M113s, Bradleys late. Air: Hueys then early Apaches, one A-10 or F-14. Weapons: M16A2, AK-47, M60, TOW, Stinger. Products: analog radios, CRT sets, cassette/VHS, typewriters, landlines. No MRAPs, JLTVs, F-35s, drones, smartphones, or lithium consumer kit.

tracks.name: M16A2 and AK-47
tracks.summary: M16A2, AK-47, and the 30-06 already in the locker. What people own in 1985.

tracks.name: Workshop Salvage
tracks.summary: M60 belts, ALICE webbing, analog radios, typewriter desks, hand-loaded 7.62.

tracks.name: Winter Kit
tracks.summary: Surplus parkas, Yukon stoves, landlines, CRT weather sets, cassette logs — not new weapons.

tracks.name: Jeeps and Pickups
tracks.summary: CJ Jeeps, F-series pickups, early Humvees with a pintle M60 or 12.7. No MRAPs, no JLTVs.

tracks.name: TOW and Stinger
tracks.summary: Jeep-mount TOW tubes and shoulder Stingers. Analog sights — no fire-and-forget toys.

tracks.name: M113s, Bradleys late
tracks.summary: M113 hulks on cannibalized parts. A Bradley only if the shop and the calendar both hold.

tracks.name: Hueys, then Apaches
tracks.summary: UH-1s first. Early AH-64s if the pad and the JP-4 hold. Not a drone.

tracks.name: A-10 or F-14
tracks.summary: One A-10 or F-14 off a frozen strip — not a squadron and not an F-35.
